REAPER TRACKPAD ENGINE — INSTALLATION GUIDE
============================================

Architecture: Apple Silicon (arm64) only
Extension file: reaper_trackpadengine.dylib

REQUIREMENTS
------------

- macOS on an Apple Silicon Mac
- The native Apple Silicon version of REAPER
- An Apple trackpad or Magic Trackpad

This build will not load in the Intel version of REAPER or on an Intel Mac.

INSTALLATION
------------

1. Fully quit REAPER with Command-Q. Closing only the project is not enough.

2. Download reaper_trackpadengine.dylib from this folder on GitHub.

3. In Finder, choose Go > Go to Folder and enter:

   ~/Library/Application Support/REAPER/UserPlugins

4. Create the UserPlugins folder if it does not exist.

5. Copy reaper_trackpadengine.dylib directly into UserPlugins.

6. Start REAPER and open the Action List.

7. Search for "Trackpad Engine" and run this action once:

   Trackpad Engine: Toggle engine (all gestures)

   A checkmark means the complete engine is enabled. The first installation
   starts with all gestures disabled for safety. The setting is saved and
   restored automatically on later launches.

WHAT IT ENABLES
---------------

- Smooth horizontal scrolling in the Arrange view
- Smooth vertical scrolling in the Arrange view and Track Control Panel
- Simultaneous two-axis, diagonal, and circular scrolling
- Horizontal scrolling in the Mixer
- Pinch-to-zoom anchored to REAPER's edit cursor with adaptive momentum

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------

If the Trackpad Engine actions do not appear:

1. Confirm that REAPER was fully quit before installing the file.
2. Confirm the exact filename: reaper_trackpadengine.dylib
3. Confirm that the file is directly inside the UserPlugins folder.
4. Confirm that both the Mac and REAPER are Apple Silicon/arm64.

macOS may quarantine files downloaded from the internet. Only if you trust
this download, open Terminal and run:

   xattr -d com.apple.quarantine "$HOME/Library/Application Support/REAPER/UserPlugins/reaper_trackpadengine.dylib"

Then fully quit and reopen REAPER.

UPDATING
--------

Quit REAPER, replace the old dylib with the new one, and restart REAPER. Saved
gesture settings are preserved.

UNINSTALLING
------------

Quit REAPER, delete reaper_trackpadengine.dylib from UserPlugins, and restart
REAPER.

FILE VERIFICATION
-----------------

Run this command from the download folder:

   shasum -a 256 reaper_trackpadengine.dylib

Compare the result with SHA256SUMS.txt in this folder.
